scope: All 232 previously populated mappings in current main: 203 DSA and 29 Java. Originally empty entries are unchanged.
method: Concept-title review plus available publisher descriptions/chapter metadata and cited presenter resource pages. Coverage notes distinguish partial compound-topic coverage. This is not a full transcript, playback or factual audit of each third-party video.

entries.basis: Euler’s totient function. Euler’s theorem and algorithmic applications are expanded in the lesson.

entries.concept: Matrix Exponentiation: Fibonacci in O(log N) and Any Linear Recurrence
entries.basis: Fibonacci via logarithmic-time matrix exponentiation. Other linear recurrences are developed in the lesson.

entries.concept: Inclusion–Exclusion: Counting Without Double-Counting
entries.basis: The inclusion–exclusion principle, a worked example and its proof.

entries.concept: Catalan Numbers: Brackets, Trees, Mountains and More
entries.basis: Catalan-number applications including valid bracket strings and tree shapes.

entries.concept: Game Theory: Winning & Losing Positions, Nim and Sprague–Grundy
entries.basis: Winning/losing states in impartial games. Nim and Sprague–Grundy theory are developed further in the lesson.

entries.concept: Vectors, Cross Product & Orientation (the CCW Test)
entries.basis: Orientation/cross-product tests used in line-segment intersection. Vector foundations are explained in the lesson.

entries.concept: Convex Hull: Andrew's Monotone Chain & Graham Scan
entries.basis: Convex hull with Graham scan and Jarvis march. Andrew’s monotone-chain variant is developed in the lesson.

entries.concept: Reservoir Sampling: Fair Random Picks from a Stream of Unknown Length
entries.basis: Reservoir sampling for a uniform random linked-list node in one pass.

entries.concept: Randomized Algorithms: Fisher–Yates Shuffle & Randomized Quickselect
entries.basis: Fisher–Yates uniform shuffling with a physical demonstration and JavaScript implementation. Randomized quickselect is a separate part of the lesson.

entries.concept: Skip Lists: Express Lanes over a Sorted Linked List
entries.basis: Skip-list express lanes over a sorted linked list.

entries.concept: LFU Cache: Frequency Buckets + minFreq for O(1) Eviction
entries.basis: LFU cache using frequency buckets and a tracked minimum frequency.

entries.concept: Skip List: A Sorted Linked List with Express Lanes
entries.basis: Skip-list express lanes over a sorted linked list. Insertion and randomized-height implementation details are expanded in the lesson.

entries.concept: Bloom Filter: "Definitely Not" or "Probably Yes" in a Few Bits
entries.basis: Bloom-filter membership with false positives and no false negatives under the stated insertion-only model.

entries.concept: Time-Based Key-Value Store: Versions + Binary Search for "As Of" Reads
entries.basis: A time-based key/value store with version histories and binary search.

entries.concept: Autocomplete System: Trie + Top-K Suggestions per Prefix
entries.basis: Prefix-based search suggestions using a trie, with Python code and a worked example. The lesson develops cached top-K suggestions per prefix.

entries.concept: The Master Pattern Map: Clue → Technique
entries.basis: A survey of common coding-interview concepts. Use the lesson’s clue-to-technique map for the complete pattern checklist.

entries.concept: Reading Constraints: The Complexity Budget
entries.basis: Relate input constraints to approximate computational budgets. Timing depends on the language, hardware and judge; operation counts are heuristics.

entries.concept: How to Approach an Unseen Problem
entries.basis: A structured approach to an unfamiliar DSA question, from understanding it to developing and checking a solution.

entries.concept: Mixed Timed Problem Sets: Practising Like the Real Thing
entries.basis: A timed coding interview with progress checkpoints and a debrief. Use it as a timed rehearsal alongside the lesson’s mixed problem sets.

entries.concept: Mock Interview Walkthroughs: What a Strong Round Sounds Like
entries.basis: A complete mock round covering clarification, brute force, optimization, recursion, dynamic programming and implementation.

entries.concept: Communicating Trade-offs Like a Senior Engineer
entries.basis: Compare a brute-force solution with optimized approaches and communicate the reasoning before implementation.

entries.concept: Common Mistakes (and the Habit That Prevents Each)
entries.basis: C++ coding habits and pitfalls. Use the lesson’s language-neutral checklist for Java, Python and JavaScript as well.

entries.concept: Final Revision Checklists & Your Last-Week Plan
entries.basis: Last-minute coding-interview revision advice. The lesson supplies the structured final-week checklist and schedule.

entries.concept: Installing the JDK & Compile vs Run (javac → bytecode → java)
entries.basis: Install the JDK and IDE, create Main.java and run a first Java program. The lesson expands javac, bytecode and command-line compilation.

entries.concept: JDK vs JRE vs JVM — and What Lives Inside the JVM
entries.basis: The responsibilities of the JDK, JRE and JVM. JVM memory/runtime internals are expanded in the lesson.

entries.concept: The main Method, Command-Line Arguments & Exit Codes
entries.basis: The Java main-method declaration and entry point. Command-line parsing and exit codes are expanded in the lesson.

entries.concept: Primitive Types, Ranges, Literals & Defaults
entries.basis: Java’s primitive data types. Numeric ranges, literal syntax and defaults are expanded in the lesson.

entries.concept: Type Casting: Widening, Narrowing & Numeric Promotion
entries.basis: Java widening/narrowing conversion and casts. Numeric-promotion edge cases are expanded in the lesson.

entries.concept: Integer Overflow: Wrap-Around, Detection & Prevention
entries.basis: Java primitive casting and numeric overflow. Checked arithmetic and prevention techniques are expanded in the lesson.

entries.concept: char, ASCII & Unicode (UTF-16, Code Points, Emoji)
entries.basis: Unicode code points and character encodings. Java UTF-16 char/surrogate-pair behavior is expanded in the lesson.

entries.concept: Decisions: if/else, the Ternary Operator, switch & Switch Expressions
entries.basis: Java if/else branching. Ternary expressions and modern switch expressions are separate parts of the lesson.

entries.concept: Jumping Out Early: break, continue and Labelled Loops
entries.basis: Java break, continue, labeled variants and return.

entries.concept: Methods, the Call Stack and Why Java Is Always Pass-by-Value
entries.basis: Why Java passes values, including copied reference values. Method-stack mechanics are expanded in the lesson.

entries.concept: Method Overloading and Varargs (int... args)
entries.basis: Java variable-argument methods. Overloading resolution is expanded in the lesson.

entries.concept: 1D Arrays, 2D Arrays and Jagged Arrays
entries.basis: Java two-dimensional arrays. One-dimensional and jagged-array details are expanded in the lesson.

entries.concept: String Basics: The Everyday Methods (and Their Traps)
entries.basis: Common Java String operations and methods. The lesson adds their traps and edge cases.

entries.concept: Defining Classes & Creating Objects
entries.basis: Define a Java class, construct objects, access instance fields and call instance methods.

entries.concept: References: Stack vs Heap, Aliasing, null & Pass-by-Value
entries.basis: Java object references versus primitive values and stack/heap diagrams. Null, aliasing and pass-by-value are expanded in the lesson.

entries.concept: Constructors & Constructor Chaining
entries.basis: Java constructors and object initialization. this()/super() chaining details are expanded in the lesson.

entries.concept: The this Keyword
entries.basis: Using this to refer to the current Java object.

entries.concept: static: Fields, Methods & Blocks
entries.basis: Java static versus instance variables and methods. Static initialization blocks are expanded in the lesson.

entries.concept: Initialization Order: static, instance, constructor
entries.basis: Static fields and blocks, instance fields and blocks, and constructor chaining in initialization order for Java 21.

entries.concept: Access Modifiers & Packages
entries.basis: Java public, protected, package-private and private access. Package organization is expanded in the lesson.

entries.concept: Encapsulation: Private Data, Public Behaviour, Guarded Invariants
entries.basis: Encapsulation, data hiding and abstraction. The lesson develops guarded invariants with Java examples.

entries.concept: Inheritance, extends & super: Reusing a Parent and Building Objects Layer by Layer
entries.basis: Superclass fields, methods and constructors through Java’s super keyword. The lesson introduces extends and the complete inheritance model.

entries.concept: Method Overriding Rules: Signature, Return Type, Access, Exceptions, @Override
entries.basis: Java method overriding. Covariant returns, visibility and checked-exception restrictions are expanded in the lesson.

entries.concept: Polymorphism: Compile-Time (Overloading) vs Runtime (Dynamic Dispatch)
entries.basis: Runtime polymorphism and dynamic dispatch in Java. Overloading is the compile-time counterpart in the lesson.

entries.concept: Abstract Classes: Half-Built Blueprints and the Template Method
entries.basis: Abstract classes, abstract methods and their contrast with interfaces. The Template Method pattern is developed in the lesson.

entries.concept: Interfaces: Contracts, default & static Methods, and the Diamond Rules
entries.basis: Java interface contracts. Default/static methods and conflicting-default rules are expanded in the lesson.

entries.concept: final: Variables, References, Methods and Classes
entries.basis: The different meanings of final on variables, methods and classes. A final reference does not make its object immutable.

entries.concept: Composition vs Inheritance: HAS-A Beats IS-A (Most of the Time)
entries.basis: IS-A versus HAS-A, fragile inheritance hierarchies, and refactoring to composition and delegation.

entries.concept: The Object Class: equals, hashCode, toString, getClass, clone, wait/notify, finalize
entries.basis: Object methods equals, toString and hashCode. Other Object methods and finalize deprecation are expanded in the lesson.
